I need p'(r) where r is the largest root, without exposing the full root list.

Let me find only the largest root directly by testing candidate values from the top of the allowed range downward, checking p(x) = 0.

Test x = 10: 10000 - 17000 + 10100 - 2470 + 210 = 840. Not zero.
Test x = 9: 6561 - 12393 + 8181 - 2223 + 210 = 336. Not zero.
Test x = 8: 4096 - 8704 + 6464 - 1976 + 210 = 90. Not zero.
Test x = 7: 2401 - 5831 + 4949 - 1729 + 210 = 0. Zero!

So the largest root is r = 7 (since 8, 9, 10 are not roots).

Now compute p'(x) = 4x³ - 51x² + 202x - 247.

p'(7) = 4(343) - 51(49) + 202(7) - 247
= 1372 - 2499 + 1414 - 247
= 40.

Final answer: 40
